title: Macklemore’s Next Show Is at Red Rocks — and He’s the Headliner: Here’s How to Get Tickets
summary: The outdoor date comes after the rapper was dropped as an opening act from Ed Sheeran's tour.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Macklemore is set to make his return to the stage in October with a headlining gig at Red Rocks, the iconic open-air amphitheater in Morrison, Colo.

The rapper takes to the stage at Red Rocks on Thursday, Oct. 22, with a showtime of 7 p.m. local time. This is just a one-off show — Macklemore was supposed to be on tour opening for Ed Sheeran through November, until the rapper was dropped from the bill for making pro-Palestinian comments during a concert in New Jersey.

While fans won’t be able to see the “Same Love” rapper on the bill with Sheeran, they can still find tickets to his Red Rocks Amphitheatre show in October.

FIND MACKLEMORE TICKETS ON TICKETMASTER

Ticketmaster is the official ticketing provider for Macklemore at Red Rocks, and while the public onsale is mostly sold out, you can still find verified resale tickets available at Ticketmaster.com .

You can also find Macklemore tickets online through third-party marketplaces and reseller sites, all of which guarantee authentic tickets delivered in time for the show or your money back.

TOP PICK

Find Macklemore Tickets on StubHub

$170

FIND TICKETS HERE

StubHub is a popular resale site that has Macklemore Red Rocks tickets starting at $170 (as of this writing) for the general admission section.

StubHub lets you search for seats by price, section, view and perks (like included parking or VIP entry). The site’s all-in pricing means you’ll see the full cost upfront with no hidden fees at checkout.

EDITOR'S CHOICE

Find Macklemore Tickets on SeatGeek

$162

SeatGeek is another third-party site with Macklemore tickets available. Pricing ranges from $162 for general admission to $367 right next to the stage (which is the cheapest price we are seeing for that front section).

SeatGeek’s interactive seating map lets you see a simulated view of the stage from your selected seats before you check out. A bonus: Use our exclusive promo code BILLBOARD10 to take $10 off your purchase at SeatGeek.com .

LOWEST PRICES

Find Macklemore Tickets on Vivid Seats

$155

The lowest prices we’re seeing for Macklemore Red Rocks tickets is at Vivid Seats, with stubs starting at $155.

You should also consider Vivid Seats if you’re buying group tickets: The site has a rewards program that gives you your 11th ticket free (in the form of a site credit) after you buy 10 tickets online.

The Red Rocks show will mark Macklemore’s first concert since he was dropped from Sheeran’s Loop Tour, after Gillette Stadium owner Robert Kraft banned the rapper from the venue for what the mogul called “deeply offensive and hurtful” statements “to the Jewish community.” Kraft reportedly rallied other stadium owners to do the same thing, leading to Messina Touring Group, the promoter for Sheeran’s Loop Tour, to remove Macklemore from the bill. Opening acts Finneas and Lukas Graham dropped out of the tour shortly afterward in a sign of solidarity with the “Can’t Hold Us” rapper.
